title: Aplyd Academy v0.6 as-built data dictionary candidate
status: Current local checkout; not a JSON Schema, test report, hosted-release assertion or production approval

conventions.persistence: D1 SQLite columns plus nested JSON aggregates; authoring/support do not have separate normalized tables
conventions.lengths: Text lengths are JavaScript string lengths unless noted; required minimums generally compare trimmed text. Byte limits use UTF-8 JSON.stringify size, including escaping.
conventions.timestamps: Trusted server UTC ISO strings; content reviewDueAt must round-trip YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ exactly and be future within 730 days
conventions.identity: User ID/email come from platform authentication. Display names do not grant authority. Content/support provenance name snapshots are truncated to 80 UTF-16 units.
conventions.projection: Persisted private fields are not automatically API-readable. Current membership, role, cohort scope, explicit assignment and own-history policy determine projection.
conventions.authority: admin means workspace owner. Draft author/reviewer are record relationships requiring admin for content actions; learner-appeal reviewer is a separate TEAM_ROLES value.
conventions.immutability: Immutable publication snapshot/hash remains retained after retirement; draft archival retains canonical document/history. No delete/reopen command exists for these terminal content records.

capacityRules.authoringReserve: Every active draft final archive plus every available publication retirement; largest admitted actor JSON size, bounded names/reasons and worst JSON escaping
capacityRules.supportReserve: Every open request's final requester withdrawal event with admitted requester identity and worst name escaping
capacityRules.limitation: Growth admission and terminal-capacity safeguards, not production scale/SLA evidence or an unconditional repair guarantee for externally oversized/corrupt records
